title: Reliance Industries green energy arm commissions 1 GW solar capacity in Gujarat
summary: Reliance New Energy has commissioned an additional 1 GW solar module manufacturing capacity at its Jamnagar gigafactory complex, advancing its net-carbon-neutrality roadmap ahead of scheduled capital expenditure targets.

title: TCS secures multi-year digital transformation deal exceeding $1.2B with European insurer
summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced an expansive multi-year partnership with a premier European financial group to modernize core cloud infrastructure and deploy generative AI client servicing solutions.

title: HDFC Bank reports 17% YoY credit growth while Net Interest Margin stabilizes at 3.65%
summary: India's largest private sector lender HDFC Bank posted steady operational metrics with gross advances growing 17% year-on-year, while credit costs remained benign and capital adequacy ratio stood comfortably at 18.2%.

title: Infosys expands AI-first platform Topaz partnerships; discretionary tech spend shows sequential recovery
summary: Infosys management noted an inflection in enterprise generative AI pilots transitioning into multi-million dollar production deployments, driven by broad adoption of the Topaz platform in banking and retail verticals.

title: ICICI Bank asset quality strengthens as gross NPA ratio drops to multi-year low of 2.15%
summary: ICICI Bank maintained solid balance sheet momentum with retail deposits increasing 19% YoY. Asset quality showed persistent improvements with provisioning coverage ratio surpassing 81%.

title: NIFTY 50 consolidates near 24,350 as foreign institutional investors turn net buyers in cash segment
summary: Domestic equity indices traded in a tight range as domestic institutional support coupled with renewed FII cash inflows of Rs 1,420 crore cushioned the index against volatility in Asian peers.

title: Crude oil volatility and rising US dollar index exert mild pressure on Indian rupee and OMC margins
summary: Brent crude futures hovered around $83 per barrel following geopolitical friction in the Middle East, posing headwinds for downstream refining margins and petrochemical spreads.

title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee maintains status quo on repo rate at 6.50%; highlights disinflation priority
summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept the benchmark repurchase rate unchanged at 6.50% while reiterating its commitment to align headline CPI inflation with the durable 4% target.

title: TCS client decision cycles remain elongated in financial services segment despite deal pipeline expansion
summary: Industry analysts note that while gross contract signings are robust, project ramp-ups in North America face cautious budgeting, keeping billing growth moderate over the near term.

title: Government raises capex allocation for national railway and highway corridors, boosting infrastructure bellwethers
summary: Budgetary disbursements toward capital infrastructure reached a record high in the October quarter, offering order book visibility for engineering, cement, and industrial conglomerates.

title: State Bank of India Q2 net profit jumps 28% YoY to Rs 18,331 crore driven by lower provisions
summary: State Bank of India (SBI) declared a historic quarterly net profit of Rs 18,331 crore, fueled by a 15.5% expansion in domestic corporate credit and an improvement in Gross NPA to 2.21%.

title: Tata Motors EV division achieves positive EBITDA margin of 4.2% as Nexon and Curvv drive volumes
summary: Tata Motors reported milestone operational profitability in its electric passenger vehicle subsidiary TPEM, posting a 4.2% EBITDA margin alongside 68% market share in the domestic passenger EV category.

title: Wipro signs $500M enterprise communications transformation agreement with US telecom major
summary: Wipro secured a five-year contract valued at $500M to modernize network orchestration and automated billing infrastructure for a leading United States telecommunications carrier.

title: Sun Pharma receives US FDA approval for novel dermatology injectable with priority review status
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries announced that the US FDA cleared its targeted biologic for plaque psoriasis, opening an addressable global annual market opportunity exceeding $2.4B.

title: Larsen & Toubro wins mega offshore order worth over Rs 15,000 crore in the Middle East energy sector
summary: L&T Hydrocarbon business bagged multiple offshore engineering and gas compression packages from a leading Gulf national oil corporation, bolstering its order book beyond Rs 4.8 lakh crore.

title: ITC agribusiness and paperboards face margin compression due to surging pulp wood and wheat prices
summary: ITC reported steady cigarette volumes but experienced 140 bps margin contraction in its non-FMCG segments caused by unseasonal rainfall disrupting domestic wood harvesting and raw agricultural procurement.

title: Hindustan Unilever rural demand volumes rebound by 5.4% YoY as crop realizations stabilize
summary: FMCG market leader Hindustan Unilever (HUL) witnessed broad-based volume growth across home care and beauty personal care categories in tier-3 towns and rural districts following bumper kharif harvesting.

title: Maruti Suzuki hybrid powertrain deliveries cross 100,000 units mark ahead of internal deadline
summary: Maruti Suzuki confirmed strong consumer appetite for its strong-hybrid Grand Vitara and Invicto models, capturing 46% of the domestic passenger vehicle hybrid market in FY26.

title: India CPI inflation cools down to 4.87% in October aided by decline in vegetable and pulse prices
summary: Ministry of Statistics data revealed headline retail consumer price inflation moderated to 4.87%, moving comfortably within the Reserve Bank of India's tolerance corridor of 2% to 6%.

title: Kotak Mahindra Bank expands digital lending book by 24% YoY with stable credit cost of 45 bps
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported healthy deposit mobilization through its 811 digital portal, sustaining net interest margin at 5.02% while keeping provision coverage high at 74%.

title: NTPC green energy arm files draft IPO papers with SEBI to raise Rs 10,000 crore for clean energy capex
summary: State-owned power utility NTPC Limited's clean energy subsidiary submitted draft offer documents for an all-fresh equity public issuance to fund 6 GW of solar and wind generation assets.

title: Mahindra and Mahindra auto sales surge 25% YoY to record 96,648 units on surging SUV demand
summary: M&M experienced unprecedented festive bookings for Thar Roxx and Scorpio-N, taking open customer order books to 185,000 vehicles with average wait times extending to 6 months.

title: Cipla launches generic respiratory inhalation therapy in Europe following patent expiry
summary: Cipla announced direct commercial rollout of its generic Fluticasone propionate dry powder inhaler across Germany, France, and Spain, aiming for a 15% European market share over two years.

title: Gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections touch Rs 1.87 lakh crore in October, up 8.9% YoY
summary: India's monthly GST mop-up recorded its second-highest monthly tally on record at Rs 1.87 lakh crore, reflecting buoyant festive consumer consumption and improved tax compliance nationwide.

title: Bharti Airtel expands 5G enterprise private network deployments in automotive manufacturing hubs
summary: Telecom major Bharti Airtel partnered with robotic automation leaders to deploy dedicated standalone 5G networks in auto component factories across Chennai, Pune, and Manesar.
